map.退保比例和退保率是一回事吗？: Are the Surrender Ratio and the Surrender Rate the Same Thing?
map.不是。退保比例是准备金中实际返还给客户的比例（受最小现金价值监管约束），退保率是: No. The surrender ratio is the share of the reserve actually returned to the customer (constrained by minimum cash value regulation), whereas the surrender rate is lapsed policies divided by in-force policies — the denominators differ.
